headline: Egypt Expands African Export Strategy as Regional Trade Hits $214 Billion
summary: Egypt's Industry Ministry announced initiatives to broaden export destinations across Africa, capitalizing on intra-African trade that reached $214 billion, backed by Afreximbank partnerships.
why: Expanding continental trade diversification is vital for Egypt to generate foreign exchange reserves and stimulate domestic manufacturing output.

impacts.name: Manufacturing
impacts.why: Enhanced bilateral trade channels and export financing improve overseas market access for domestic producers.
